newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM SHARES RISE AS INVESTORS DIGEST RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: KLM SHARES RISE AS INVESTORS DIGEST RESULTS.

text.p: Shares in Dutch flag carrier KLM soared more than five percent to 80.00 guilders early on Wednesday in follow-through buying on the back of yesterday's higher-than-expected first quarter earnings.
"The results were much better than we thought and this morning many analysts have raised their estimates. The year ahead for KLM looks pretty good right now," one dealer said.
On Tuesday KLM reported operating profits for the first quarter of the 1997/98 financial year had tripled to 244 million guilders as traffic revenues had outstripped costs.
